summary: Spark community discussions are focused on expanding data source options, experimenting with AI‑assisted code review, and unifying UDF execution across languages. A proposal to add an ADBC data source would return Arrow record batches for efficient columnar reads and writes. A trial AI bot using Claude is reviewing pull‑request diffs, while a language‑agnostic UDF protocol aims to standardize UDF execution in Spark Connect.

highlights.text: Proposal to add a built‑in ADBC data source that returns Arrow record batches for columnar reads and writes
Trial of an AI code review bot using Claude to analyze diffs and post inline comments on new Spark pull requests

sources.title: [DISCUSS] Automated AI code review on new Spark PRs (trial)

highlights.text: Introduction of a language‑agnostic UDF protocol to unify API and execution across multiple programming languages in Spark Connect

sources.title: SPIP: Language-agnostic UDF Protocol for Spark
